body.name: Nested averaging and common-refinement handle
body.construction: Smooth an arbitrary feasible rule by covariance-matched Gaussian convolution; average the smoothed rule over nested tangential boxes ordered by the incidence poset; project each stratum through the \(\Sigma\)-orthogonal normal quotient; flatten \(v,b\) only for geometry and computation while retaining the projection \(v,b\mapsto v\) for honesty and loss; and place all nonempty component charts on one exact common rational conical refinement before defining \(\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\).
